vulnerabilities.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Elextensions ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System elex-helpdesk-customer-support-ticket-system allows Object Injection.This issue affects ELEX WordPress HelpDesk & Customer Ticketing System: from n/a through 3.3.9.

NginxPulse 1.5.0 before 1.6.26 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to append SQL via the id and locationType parameters of /api/stats/:type. Attackers can close the quoted table-name identifier and use error-based output to read database contents, and read or write server files via PostgreSQL superuser functions.

The AutomatorWP Pro plugin for WordPress' webhook addon is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.4. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to reset the password of any WordPress account, including administrators, resulting in full account takeover. This is only exploitable when an administrator has configured an automation pairing a Receive Webhook

Huatian Dynamic OA8000 collaborative office system contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in /OAapp/jsp/trace/ntkodownload.jsp, where the filename request parameter is used to locate a file without restricting access to an intended directory or rejecting traversal sequences. Attackers can supply ../ sequences to read arbitrary files from the server, such as the Tomcat configuration at ROOT/WEB-INF/web.xml, exposing sensitive configuration, source, and credential material that c

Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force six-digit password reset codes via PUT /apis/user/forget-password. Attackers can request a code for a known email and submit unlimited guesses during its 300-second lifetime to set a chosen password and take over the account.

The Optimole – Optimize Images | Convert WebP & AVIF | CDN & Lazy Load | Image Optimization plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_urls_in_value function in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.19. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). Successful exploitation

Injection Guard plugin for WordPress before 1.4.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger password hash export by tricking a logged-in administrator into loading a crafted link, since the ig_settings admin page in templates/dashboard.php processes GET parameters without nonce verification. Attackers can exploit this to cause the plugin to write WooCommerce customer email hashes and password hashes to an unprotected file at wp-content/p

Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, _payload.json URL generation and the experimental early-404 path use a trailing-slash regular expression whose work grows quadratically with a long run of slash characters. An unauthenticated request can synchronously occupy the Node.js event loop and delay other requests when server-side rendering uses isr, swr, or cache route rules, or when experimental.early404 is enabled. The Chargely Free Subscriptions For Woocommernce WordPress plugin through 1.0 does not perform any authorization check on a REST API route that returns its stored configuration, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the live WooCommerce REST API consumer key and secret it holds, which grant read and write access to the whole store.

The Checkout Files Upload for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 2.4.1 does not verify that a file uploaded at checkout is really one of its allowed image types, and serves stored uploads inline using their detected content type, allowing unauthenticated users to upload an HTML file disguised as an image that executes JavaScript in the browser of a shop manager or administrator who opens it from the order screen.
This is a regression of CVE-2025-4212, reintroduced in 2.4.0.

The Lightbox with PhotoSwipe WordPress plugin before 5.19.0 does not properly sanitise link titles and other caption sources before inserting them as HTML into the image lightbox caption, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks via comments.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in WP BASE WP BASE Booking wp-base-booking-of-appointments-services-and-events allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects WP BASE Booking: from n/a through 6.5.2.

Hugo Blog is a tech blog site. In commit 744ca15 and prior, the AI assistant proxy exposes three HTTP endpoints (POST /api/blog-assistant, POST /api/blog-search-embedding, POST /api/blog-search-rerank) without any authentication check. When deployed following the documented Nginx reverse-proxy setup, any unauthenticated remote attacker can send arbitrary requests that the proxy forwards to the upstream LLM/embedding/rerank API using the operator's server-side API key (OPENAI_API_KEY / AI_SEARCH_

MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect reset links by forging the Host header when $url_base is unset. Attackers can request a reset for a victim so AuthDb::notifyUser() emails a link pointing to their host, capturing the reset key when opened to take over accounts including administrators.

BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, and 1.6.1, bws_srv_start() in ports/linux/websocket-srv.c builds the libwebsockets server context with a CA certificate loaded but never sets LWS_SERVER_OPTION_REQUIRE_VALID_OPENSSL_CLIENT_CERT, so the hub accepts TLS connections from clients presenting no certificate at all. Any network-reachable host can join the BACnet/SC mesh without credentials. This issue has been patched in

Kanbanz by Softaculous plugin for WordPress before 1.0.3 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated Kanban Staff users to access and modify boards they are not members of by exploiting admin-ajax handlers that fail to call kanbanz_user_can_access_board() or per-task edit checks on attacker-supplied board_id or task_id parameters. Attackers can supply arbitrary board IDs to read sensitive task data, overwrite status columns, subtasks, and labels, inject comments, upl

Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From @nuxt/webpack-builder 3.0.0 and @nuxt/rspack-builder 3.12.2 until 4.6.4, the development middleware trusts Origin, Referer, or Sec-Fetch-Site when the Host header names the same attacker-controlled hostname. Incorrect default permissions in the agent configuration folder in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and earlier allows a local unprivileged user to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM via a crafted agent configuration file that points the agent to an attacker-controlled server.

The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not enforce the acting user's publish and post-type restrictions on an AJAX save action, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to publish their own content and change its post type (for example to a product) without holding the required capabilities.

The Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 was distributed with a hidden update mechanism that fetched Quick Page/Post Redirect Plugin WordPress plugin before 5.2.4 updates from its author's own server instead of WordPress.org, which was used to push a backdoored build to sites, allowing the attacker controlling that server to inject arbitrary content into pages and to deliver arbitrary code to affected sites.

A flaw has been found in projectworlds Visitor Management System 1.0. This vulnerability affects the function mysqli_query of the file actionpage.php. This manipulation of the argument purpose causes sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

A vulnerability has been found in projectworlds Visitor Management System 1.0. This issue affects the function mysqli_query of the file /img/user%20page.php of the component Login Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument Username leads to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Jacob N. Breetvelt WP Photo Album Plus wp-photo-album-plus allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects WP Photo Album Plus: from n/a through 9.3.06.001.

Poste Italiane Postecert FIRMAOK! 1.6.29 on Windows contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability caused by an uncontrolled OpenSSL search path, where launcher.exe and dependent executables such as updater.exe and tslupdater.exe load OpenSSL configuration and library files from a hardcoded, user-writable directory that does not exist by default. A low-privileged local attacker can create this missing directory and place malicious OpenSSL configuration or library files inside it, causing th

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.7.2.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in rtCamp Inc. rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress buddypress-media allows Stored XSS.This issue affects rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress: from n/a through 4.7.16.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Go Maps WP Go Maps wp-google-maps allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Go Maps: from n/a through 10.1.10.

Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the underlying MSSQL database, enabling exfiltration of sensitive property and  taxpayer information.

Keep 0.34.10 through 0.55.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in its CEL-to-SQL converter, which inserts bracket-indexed JSON keys from CEL filters unescaped into JSON path expressions for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Authenticated users with read:alert permission can submit crafted CEL expressions to /alerts/query or the cel parameter of /incidents, using result counts as a boolean oracle to extract other tenants' alerts and password hashes.

Post to Google My Business plugin for WordPress before 3.5.7 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Contributor-level privileges or higher to make the server send requests to arbitrary hosts by supplying an unvalidated mbp_post_attachment URL that reaches a raw getimagesize() call in validate_external_image_size() via the preview REST route. Attackers can exploit this to perform internal port scanning, probe internal-only services and clou

The Flatsome theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'data-text-sec', 'data-title', and 'title' Attributes via Custom HTML Block in all versions up to, and including, 3.20.12 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives server-side sanitiza

Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification) vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_core and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via a compressed Erlang external term in a gRPC message body.

In FRRouting (FRR) 8.3 through 10.5.1, bgp_notify_decapsulate_hard_reset() in bgpd/bgp_packet.c does not validate the length of the data field of a received BGP NOTIFICATION Cease/Hard Reset message (RFC 8538). When the data field is exactly one byte long, the function reads one byte past the end of a heap buffer and the 16-bit length of the encapsulated data underflows to 65535, causing a 65535-byte out-of-bounds heap read followed by an assertion failure. Incorrect privilege assignment in the app token management component in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and earlier allows an authenticated user with token creation or update permissions to escalate privileges to administrator, and allows a revoked app token to be reinstated in multi-node deployments, via crafted app token requests that set an arbitrary role or revocation state.

The Email Marketing 4Dem WordPress plugin through 2.0.5 does not perform authorization or capability checks on several of its AJAX actions and REST routes, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the Email Marketing 4Dem WordPress plugin through 2.0.5's stored configuration and data and to modify its stored settings.

The Email Marketing 4Dem WordPress plugin through 2.0.5 does not perform authorization or capability checks on several of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to destroy its stored configuration and delete its records.

The Countdown, Coming Soon, Maintenance  WordPress plugin through 3.0.8 does not perform authorization or nonce checks when saving countdown data on post save, and its output-sanitization allowlist permits script tags, allowing users with Author-level access and above to store arbitrary web scripts that execute when the affected content is viewed on the front end or in an administrator session.

The Countdown, Coming Soon, Maintenance  WordPress plugin through 3.0.8 does not check that the user is allowed to browse content before returning post titles from one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to list the titles of published entries of any post type, including types that WordPress does not expose to them. Draft, private and pending content is not returned; only published entries are disclosed.

The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action available to unauthenticated users, and does not restrict the status of the posts it returns by ID, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the content of unpublished (draft and pending) posts.

The Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 does not perform a capability check when saving its global settings, relying only on its own role-access list, which allows users of any role an administrator has given Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 access to, as low as Subscriber, to overwrite those settings, including the role-access list itself.

The Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 does not check that a user duplicating a post is allowed to edit it, which, when the slug takeover option is enabled, allows users of a role an administrator has given Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 access to, such as Contributor, to move any readable post off its permalink and publish their copy at that address.

The Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 does not check whether a user may publish posts when duplicating one, allowing users of a role an administrator has given Duplicate Post WordPress plugin before 1.5.8 access to, such as Contributors, to create published posts, including posts attributed to other users.

The Swipe WordPress plugin through 1.4 does not properly authenticate a login request before issuing a WordPress session cookie, allowing unauthenticated attackers to log in as an existing user, including an administrator, when that user has an active app session.

The SEOJuice WordPress plugin before 2.12.0 does not correctly restrict a REST API authentication filter, disabling WordPress's REST nonce protection for the whole site and allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform any cookie-authenticated REST action, including creating a new administrator account, by tricking a logged-in administrator into opening a crafted page (CSRF).

The WP Ultimate CSV Importer  WordPress plugin before 9.2, WP Ultimate CSV Importer Pro WordPress plugin before 9.0.7 do not protect the files created by their single post export feature, writing them to a publicly accessible location under a predictable name, allowing unauthenticated attackers to download the content and custom fields of any exported post, including non-public content.

The WP Ultimate CSV Importer  WordPress plugin before 9.3 does not escape values from imported files before using them in SQL queries when importing LifterLMS content, allowing high privilege users such as admin, including the administrator of a single site on a multisite network, to perform SQL injection attacks.
